name: ncrypted
description: One-time, end-to-end encrypted secrets for agents. Share passwords and API keys as self-destructing links. 0.005 USDC per secret via x402.

settings.name: Wallet private key (optional)
settings.description: Private key of a dedicated Base wallet holding USDC, used to pay 0.005 USDC per secret. Leave empty to use ~/.config/ncrypted/wallet.key (create it with `npx ncrypted wallet new`). Reading secrets is free.
